ordinary_F0_germ_proof.uniqueness: The same anchored G/logC/Lambda define one positive F0. The coefficient ODE uniquely determines both m=1 and m=2 normalized germs.
ordinary_F0_germ_proof.angular: Common F0/F0base cancels in angular/f; its differentiated terms remain in the numerator.
ordinary_F0_germ_proof.swirl: C2 uses raw F0^2 germ divided by constant F0base^2. C6 divides by variable F0^2 then multiplies back before the physical ODE.
